title: Quickstart: install + .env + minimum app
description: Fresh Next.js / React app talking to NERO Chain via Web3Auth social login + account abstraction + paymaster in ~30 lines. Start here.
code:
# 1. Install
npm install @web3auth/modal ethers wagmi @tanstack/react-query \
  @ethersproject/providers @ethersproject/units
npm install userop@https://github.com/nerochain/aa-userop-sdk.git

# 2. .env.local (testnet)
cat > .env.local <<'EOF'
NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID=your-web3auth-client-id
NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB3AUTH_NETWORK=SAPPHIRE_DEVNET
NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAIN_ID=0x2B1
NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL=https://rpc-testnet.nerochain.io
NEXT_PUBLIC_BUNDLER_URL=https://bundler-testnet.nerochain.io
NEXT_PUBLIC_PAYMASTER_URL=https://paymaster-testnet.nerochain.io
NEXT_PUBLIC_PAYMASTER_API=your-paymaster-api-key
NEXT_PUBLIC_ENTRY_POINT=0x5FF137D4b0FDCD49DcA30c7CF57E578a026d2789
NEXT_PUBLIC_ACCOUNT_FACTORY=0x9406Cc6185a346906296840746125a0E44976454
EOF

# 3. Run it
npm run dev

# See topics: providers-setup, wallet-hook, builder-with-paymaster-hook
# for the wiring.

title: Web3Auth + Wagmi + React Query provider stack
description: Exact provider nesting (Web3AuthProvider → QueryClientProvider → WagmiProvider) required by @web3auth/modal v10+ on NERO Chain. Includes Next.js App Router SSR hydration.

title: useBuilderWithPaymaster hook (SimpleAccount + paymaster)
description: Reusable React hook that wires userop's SimpleAccount builder to NERO's bundler + paymaster. Supports Type 0 (sponsored), Type 1+ (ERC-20), and no-paymaster modes.

title: Complete useWallet hook (connect, send, stake, balance)
description: Production-ready React hook tying Web3Auth + paymaster builder together. Exposes {state, actions} for isConnected/scwAddress/balance plus connect/disconnect/send/stake/refetchBalance.

title: Send a gasless transaction (Type 0 sponsorship)
description: End-to-end gasless native NERO transfer: build a UserOperation, let paymaster cover gas, submit to bundler, wait for receipt. Works in both server-side JS and the useWallet hook.

title: Send a UserOperation (low-level pattern)
description: Lower-level UserOperation construction without the React hook. Useful for Node.js backends, CLIs, and bots.

title: Batch multiple calls in one UserOperation
description: Queue N executions on the same SimpleAccount builder before sending. The bundler settles them in one on-chain tx, saving gas and guaranteeing atomic ordering.

title: Gasless ERC-20 transfer
description: Encode an ERC-20 transfer as calldata and route it through paymaster-sponsored UserOperations. Users don't need native NERO.

title: Gasless NFT mint
description: Mint an ERC-721 (or drop-style) NFT without the user ever touching native gas. Same pattern as ERC-20 transfer — encode call, wrap in UserOp, let paymaster settle.

title: Stake, unstake, claim rewards (native validator contract)
description: Delegate NERO to a validator, exit the delegation, and claim rewards — all via the pre-compiled staking contract at 0x…f000. Calls go through the paymaster so delegators don't need gas NERO separate from their stake.

title: Drop-in AA Wallet UI provider
description: Prebuilt account-abstraction UI from NERO's SDK. Handles social login, key management, and signing in a single provider component — pair with the provider stack from 'providers-setup'.

title: Enable / disable Web3Auth social login methods
description: Fine-tune which social providers show up in the Web3Auth modal. Disable methods you don't want to support — less choice = cleaner UX for mass adoption.

title: Next.js App Router + Web3Auth SSR hydration
description: Restore Web3Auth state from cookies during SSR so logged-in users don't see a connect button flash on page load. Requires ssr: true in Web3AuthProvider config.

title: Fetch native NERO balance of the SCW
description: Use the Web3Auth-provided JSON-RPC provider to read the on-chain balance of the user's Smart Contract Wallet (not the EOA).

title: Fetch NERO native token price from neroscan.io
description: Read current NERO market price via the neroscan API. Useful for USD-pegged UIs and ERC-20 gas-payment UX.

title: List ERC-20 tokens accepted for gas (pm_supported_tokens)
description: Call the Paymaster JSON-RPC to find which ERC-20 tokens can be used for gas (Type 1/2) and their current price ratios vs NERO.

title: Complete React wallet page (connect + send + balance)
description: Minimal full-stack React page using useWallet. Copy/paste into pages/wallet.tsx, wire the providers, and you have a working social-login AA wallet with gasless send.

title: LINE mini app specifics (redirect uxMode, viewport, Japanese)
description: Adjustments for LINE mini apps: force redirect mode for Web3Auth (popups are blocked inside LINE), set Japanese defaults, and pin viewport scaling for LIFF browsers.

title: Common AA + paymaster errors and recovery
description: Cheat-sheet mapping common runtime errors in the Web3Auth + userop + paymaster stack to their causes and the one-line fix.

title: Deploy a contract to NERO testnet with Hardhat
description: Minimal Hardhat config for NERO testnet plus a deploy script. See the full walkthrough in the Cookbook.

title: Deploy from Remix to NERO testnet
description: Point Remix at NERO testnet via the Injected Provider flow using MetaMask.
code:
1. Open https://remix.ethereum.org and load your contract.
2. Add NERO testnet to MetaMask:
   - RPC URL: https://rpc-testnet.nerochain.io
   - Chain ID: 689 (0x2B1)
   - Currency: NERO
   - Block explorer: https://testnet.neroscan.io
3. In Remix → Deploy & Run → Environment: Injected Provider - MetaMask.
4. Compile, Deploy, and confirm in MetaMask.
5. Verify on the NERO block explorer per the tutorial.
